definition: Decline porn is an Internet phenomenon and genre of multimedia content shared on social media depicting Western metropolises—such as London, Manchester, New York City, or San Francisco—as areas suffering from severe urban and civilizational collapse.
details: The content typically focuses on crime, substance abuse, litter, and immigration, frequently blaming immigrants or political negligence for the situation. Beyond using selectively edited footage of street crime, vandalism, or homelessness taken out of context, creators extensively utilize manipulative techniques, including generative artificial intelligence and deepfakes, to spread these narratives.

explainer.lead: Decline porn is a social-media genre that presents cities such as London, New York City, or San Francisco as collapsing into chaos. It matters because selective footage, generative AI, and deepfakes can turn isolated urban problems into a misleading story of civilizational breakdown, often while blaming immigrants or politicians.

tiers.eli5: Imagine filming the one messy corner of a playground, adding a made-up scene of a fight, and telling everyone the whole school is falling apart. Decline porn does something similar with cities, using frightening pictures and videos to make problems look total and unavoidable. Sometimes the scenes are real but shown without context, and sometimes computers are used to fake them.
tiers.practitioner: An engineer encountering the term would treat it as a multimedia content problem rather than a model or algorithm: examine clips for selective editing, missing context, generated material, and deepfakes. Typical review settings involve social-media posts combining footage with claims of citywide collapse. Pitfalls include treating every depiction of urban disorder as decline porn and assuming that authentic-looking footage establishes a broader trend.
tiers.paperLevel: Let c be a multimedia artifact shared on social media; c belongs to the genre when it represents a Western metropolis as undergoing severe urban or civilizational collapse, typically through themes of crime, substance abuse, litter, or immigration. Its evidentiary basis may be selectively edited or decontextualized real footage, generative-AI content, deepfakes, or a combination of these. The label characterizes a narrative and its presentation, not a quantitative measurement of urban conditions, and individual artifacts need not use every listed technique.

explainer.example: A creator combines selectively edited footage of litter and homelessness in San Francisco with a generated scene of street crime. The resulting video is captioned as proof that the entire city is collapsing, with immigrants blamed for the supposed decline.

usedIn.name: Social media
usedIn.detail: The primary setting in which this multimedia content and its collapse narratives are shared.

usedIn.name: Generative AI
usedIn.detail: Used by creators to produce or manipulate material supporting depictions of urban collapse.

usedIn.name: Deepfakes
usedIn.detail: Used as a manipulative technique within videos advancing these narratives.

explainer.intuition: The genre turns visible urban problems into a spectacle of total decline. Its persuasive force comes from framing and manipulation: isolated or synthetic scenes are presented as evidence that an entire city or civilization is failing.
howItWorks: Select crime, substance abuse, litter, immigration, vandalism, or homelessness as the subject.
Use selectively edited real footage, generated media, or deepfakes.
Remove context that would limit what the scenes show.
Frame the material as evidence of severe citywide or civilizational collapse.
Share it on social media, often blaming immigrants or political negligence.
explainer.whyItMatters: The genre can convert genuine but localized problems into a sweeping and misleading account of urban life. AI-generated material and deepfakes expand the ways these narratives can be constructed, while their frequent focus on immigration can direct blame toward immigrants.
misconceptions: Not every video about crime, litter, or homelessness is decline porn; the defining feature is its framing as severe urban or civilizational collapse.
Not all decline porn is AI-generated: selectively edited and decontextualized real footage is also commonly used.
Showing a real incident does not by itself establish citywide collapse or justify blaming immigrants.
